source.publication: 2025 Nebraska Individual Income Tax and Amended Return Booklet (8-307-2025), with 2025 Form 1040N and Schedule I
source.section: Form 1040N PDF pages 1-2, lines 2a, 4a, 4b, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 34, 35; booklet PDF page 12 lines 2a, 4a, 4b; PDF page 13 line 5, line 6 and the Nebraska Standard Deduction Chart; PDF page 14 lines 10 to 18; PDF page 17 lines 34, 35 and the Federal Tax Liability Worksheet; PDF pages 46-49 Tax Table and over-77,760 worksheet (schedule as numbers, as settled in the record from the table); record ne_personal_exemption_credit (Form 1040N line 18, nonrefundable: lines 34 and 35)

worked: Married filing jointly, 40 and 41: interest 29,000, no earned income. The tax is under the 342 for two exemptions. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = interest 29,000.00 = 29,000.00. Federal taxable income = 29,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00, below zero, so 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040N filing status (2) married filing jointly, resident. Line 2a: 0 box(es) checked (no one born before January 2, 1961). Line 4a 1; line 4b 1; line 4c none; line 4 total 2. Line 5 federal AGI 29,000.00. Line 6 Nebraska standard deduction, chart for 0 box(es): 17,200.00; lines 7 to 9 skipped (no federal itemizing); line 10 17,200.00. Line 11 = 29,000.00 - 17,200.00 = 11,800.00. Line 12 adjustments increasing federal AGI 0.00. Line 13 adjustments decreasing federal AGI 0.00. Line 14 Nebraska taxable income = 11,800.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 11,800.00. State income after additions and subtractions (before the deduction) = 29,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 29,000.00. Line 15 tax, schedule as numbers (married_joint column): 2.46% x 8,040.00 = 197.784 + 3.51% x 3,760.00 = 131.976; total 329.760, rounded once to 329.76. The Tax Table row 11,760 to 11,860 gives 330; expected keeps the schedule. Line 16 0.00 (no lump-sum or early-distribution tax); line 17 = 329.76. Line 18 personal exemption credit = 171 x 2 = 342.00; line 34 342.00. Line 35 = 329.76 - 342.00, below zero, so 0.00 (nonrefundable: expected credits shows the 329.76 used). Federal Tax Liability Worksheet (PDF page 17): line 2 is zero or less, so line 35 is 0.00.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are fitted to the printed tax table; no rate schedule is in the sources. The start of the 5.20% band is not pinned by the table: single and married filing separately 38,793 to 38,897, head of household 57,535 to 57,639, married filing jointly 77,501 to 77,760. The table's rows also round to the dollar at the row's midpoint, and the bands do neither.
